blocks.content: A matrix organizational structure explicitly violates Henri Fayol's principle of unity of command due to its dual reporting relationships.

rows: Slower due to multiple scalar steps
Faster due to direct communication lines

items: Matrix organization is frequently tested as the structure that violates the Unity of Command principle.
V.A. Graicunas' formula for calculating direct and group relationships in span of control is a common direct question.
Differentiate between Line and Line & Staff structures, specifically regarding the advisory role of staff specialists versus scalar authority.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Line organization represents the simplest and oldest structure, characterized by direct vertical authority flow from top to bottom.
Functional organizational structure groups activities according to specialized functions like production, marketing, and finance.
Matrix organization overlays functional hierarchy with project-based teams, leading to dual reporting systems.
Span of control determines whether an organization adopts a tall structure with narrow supervision or a flat structure with wide delegation.
